rows.speaker: LOUDSPEAKER
rows.hi: "लल्लन की मिठाई में आधी चीनी, आधी चालाकी!"
rows.text: ଲଲନର ମିଠାରେ ଅଧା ଚିନି, ଅଧା ଚାଲାକି!
rows.back_en: In Lalan's sweets, there is half sugar, half cleverness!

rows.speaker: LALLAN
rows.hi: अरे! ये किसने बोला?
rows.text: ଆରେ! ଏଇଟା କିଏ କହିଲା?
rows.back_en: Hey! Who said this?

rows.speaker: LALLAN
rows.hi: मैं तो… मैं तो बस मन में सोच रहा था!
rows.text: ମୁଁ ତ... ମୁଁ ତ ଖାଲି ମନେ ମନେ ଭାବୁଥିଲି!
rows.back_en: I was... I was only thinking to myself!

rows.speaker: TITLE CARD
rows.hi: सुबह — मेले से पहले
rows.text: ସକାଳ — ମେଳା ପୂର୍ବରୁ
rows.back_en: Morning — Before the fair

rows.speaker: CHHOTU
rows.hi: चाचा! आज कौन-सी मशीन बना रहे हो?
rows.text: ଦାଦା! ଆଜି କେଉଁ ମେସିନ୍ ତିଆରି କରୁଛ?
rows.back_en: Uncle! What machine are you making today?

rows.speaker: JUGAADU CHACHA
rows.hi: ये है… "दिल की बात रेडियो"! जिसकी तरफ़ घुमाओ, उसके दिल की आवाज़ सुनाई देगी।
rows.text: ଏଇଟା ହେଉଛି... "ମନ କଥା କହିବା ରେଡିଓ"! ଯାହା ଆଡ଼କୁ ବୁଲାଇବ, ତା' ମନ କଥା ଶୁଭିବ।
rows.back_en: This is... the "Mind Reading Radio"! Whomever you turn it towards, you will hear their inner thoughts.

rows.speaker: JUGAADU CHACHA
rows.hi: पर पहले देखो मेरी "बोलती कुकर"! ये बताती है कि दाल कब पकेगी।
rows.text: କିନ୍ତୁ ଆଗେ ଦେଖ ଏଇ "କୁହୁକ କୁକର"! ଏ କହିଦେବ ଡାଲି କେତେବେଳେ ସିଝିବ।
rows.back_en: But first, look at this "magic pressure cooker"! It will tell you when the dal is cooked.

rows.speaker: CHHOTU
rows.hi: चाचा, ये बोलती कैसे है?
rows.text: ଦାଦା, ଏ କଥା କୁହେ କେମିତି?
rows.back_en: Uncle, how does it speak?

rows.speaker: GUDIYA
rows.hi: <laugh> चाचा, आपकी कुकर तो बोलने से पहले सबको नहला गई!
rows.text: ଦାଦା, ତୁମ କୁକର କହିବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ସମସ୍ତଙ୍କୁ ଗାଧୋଇ ଦେଲା!
rows.back_en: Uncle, your cooker gave everyone a bath before speaking!

rows.speaker: JUGAADU CHACHA
rows.hi: हें हें… इसका गुस्सा थोड़ा तेज़ है। चलो, असली मशीन देखो!
rows.text: ହି ହି... ଏହାର ରାଗ ଟିକେ ଅଧିକ। ଚାଲ, ଅସଲି ମେସିନ୍ ଦେଖିବା!
rows.back_en: Hee hee... its temper is a bit high. Come on, let's see the real machine!

rows.speaker: GUDIYA
rows.hi: दिल की आवाज़? चाचा, दिल तो धक-धक करता है, बात थोड़ी करता है!
rows.text: ମନର କଥା? ଦାଦା, ମନ ତ ଧକଧକ ହୁଏ, କଥା କ'ଣ କୁହେ କି!
rows.back_en: Thoughts of the mind? Uncle, the heart just beats, does it ever speak?

rows.speaker: JUGAADU CHACHA
rows.hi: करता है, बिटिया। बस कोई सुनता नहीं।
rows.text: କୁହେ ଲୋ ମା'। କିନ୍ତୁ କେହି ଶୁଣନ୍ତି ନାହିଁ।
rows.back_en: It does speak, my child. But no one listens.

rows.speaker: JUGAADU CHACHA
rows.hi: देखो! पहला टेस्ट — शेरू!
rows.text: ଦେଖ! ପ୍ରଥମ ପରୀକ୍ଷା — ଶେରୁ!
rows.back_en: Look! First test — Sheru!

rows.speaker: RADIO
rows.hi: मुझे भी लड्डू चाहिए! एक नहीं, दो!
rows.text: ମୋତେ ବି ଲଡ଼ୁ ଦରକାର! ଗୋଟେ ନୁହେଁ, ଦୁଇ!
rows.back_en: I also want laddu! Not one, two!

rows.speaker: CHHOTU
rows.hi: हाहाहा! चाचा, ये तो सच में काम करता है!
rows.text: ହା ହା ହା! ଦାଦା, ଏଇଟା ତ ସତରେ କାମ କରୁଛି!
rows.back_en: Ha ha ha! Uncle, this is really working!

rows.speaker: JUGAADU CHACHA
rows.hi: पर ध्यान रहे, अभी ये पूरी तरह तैयार नहीं है। इसे कोई बाहर नहीं ले जाएगा!
rows.text: କିନ୍ତୁ ମନେ ରଖ, ଏଇଟା ଏବେ ଯାଏଁ ପୂରା ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ ନାହିଁ। ବାହାରକୁ କେହି ନେବନି!
rows.back_en: But remember, this is not fully ready yet. No one should take it outside!

rows.speaker: CHHOTU
rows.hi: बिल्कुल नहीं, चाचा!
rows.text: ଜମା ବି ନୁହେଁ, ଦାଦା!
rows.back_en: Not at all, Uncle!

rows.speaker: GUDIYA
rows.hi: बस थोड़ी देर के लिए…
rows.text: ଖାଲି ଅଳ୍ପ ସମୟ ପାଇଁ...
rows.back_en: Just for a little while...

rows.speaker: CHHOTU
rows.hi: मेले में बड़ा मज़ा आएगा!
rows.text: ମେଳାରେ ଭାରି ମଜା ହେବ!
rows.back_en: It will be so much fun at the fair!

rows.speaker: RAJU
rows.hi: देखो मेरी पतंग! पूरे गाँव में सबसे ऊँची उड़ेगी!
rows.text: ଦେଖ ମୋ ଗୁଡ଼ି! ସାରା ଗାଁରେ ସବୁଠୁ ଉପରକୁ ଉଡ଼ିବ!
rows.back_en: Look at my kite! It will fly the highest in the whole village!

rows.speaker: CHHOTU
rows.hi: अच्छा? रेडियो, ज़रा राजू के दिल की सुनाओ!
rows.text: ହଁ କି? ରେଡିଓ, ଟିକେ ରାଜୁର ମନ କଥା ଶୁଣାଅ!
rows.back_en: Oh really? Radio, let us hear what is in Raju's mind!

rows.speaker: RADIO
rows.hi: गुड़िया मुझसे अच्छी पतंग उड़ाती है… पर ये मैं कभी नहीं मानूँगा!
rows.text: ଗୁଡ଼ିଆ ମୋଠୁ ଭଲ ଗୁଡ଼ି ଉଡ଼ାଏ... କିନ୍ତୁ ମୁଁ ଏହା କେବେ ମାନିବିନି!
rows.back_en: Gudia flies kites better than me... but I will never admit it!

rows.speaker: GUDIYA
rows.hi: हाँ! सुना सबने?
rows.text: ଶୁଣିଲ ତ ସଭିଏଁ?
rows.back_en: Did everyone hear?

rows.speaker: RAJU
rows.hi: अरे! ये… ये तो झूठी मशीन है!
rows.text: ଆରେ! ଏ... ଏଇଟା ଗୋଟେ ମିଛ ମେସିନ୍!
rows.back_en: Hey! This... this is a lying machine!

rows.speaker: RADIO
rows.hi: प्रसाद में काजू कम पड़ गए… हे भगवान, बस किसी को पता न चले!
rows.text: ପ୍ରସାଦରେ କାଜୁ କମିଗଲା... ହେ ଭଗବାନ, କେହି ଯେମିତି ଜାଣି ନ ପାରନ୍ତି!
rows.back_en: The cashews in the offering are less... Oh God, I hope no one finds out!

rows.speaker: GUDIYA
rows.hi: पंडित जी भी!
rows.text: ପଣ୍ଡିତ ନନା ବି!
rows.back_en: Even Pandit Nana!

rows.speaker: RADIO
rows.hi: सुबह से एक भी गुब्बारा नहीं बिका… आज घर क्या ले जाऊँगा?
rows.text: ସକାଳୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ବି ବେଲୁନ୍ ବିକ୍ରି ହେଲାନି... ଆଜି ଘରକୁ କ'ଣ ନେବି?
rows.back_en: Not even a single balloon has been sold since morning... what will I take home today?

rows.speaker: CHHOTU
rows.hi: गुब्बारे वाले भैया उदास हैं…
rows.text: ବେଲୁନ୍‌ବାଲା ଭାଇ ଉଦାସ ଅଛନ୍ତି...
rows.back_en: The balloon-seller brother is sad...

rows.speaker: GUDIYA
rows.hi: चलो, हम सब अपने पैसों से एक-एक गुब्बारा लेते हैं!
rows.text: ଚାଲ, ଆମେ ନିଜ ପଇସାରେ ଗୋଟେ ଲେଖାଏଁ ବେଲୁନ୍ କିଣିବା!
rows.back_en: Come on, let's buy one balloon each with our own money!

rows.speaker: MASTERJI
rows.hi: बच्चो, कल स्कूल समय पर आना। अनुशासन बहुत ज़रूरी है।
rows.text: ପିଲାମାନେ, କାଲି ସ୍କୁଲ୍ ଠିକ୍ ସମୟରେ ଆସିବ। ଶୃଙ୍ଖଳା ବହୁତ ଜରୁରୀ।
rows.back_en: Children, come to school on time tomorrow. Discipline is very important.

rows.speaker: RADIO
rows.hi: काश कल भी छुट्टी होती… और मैं दिन भर सोता रहता।
rows.text: କାଶ୍ କାଲି ବି ଛୁଟି ହୋଇଥାନ୍ତା... ଆଉ ମୁଁ ସାରା ଦିନ ଶୋଇଥାନ୍ତି।
rows.back_en: I wish tomorrow was a holiday too... and I could sleep all day.

rows.speaker: MASTERJI
rows.hi: ये… ये किसकी आवाज़ है?
rows.text: ଏଇଟା... ଏଇଟା କାହାର ସ୍ୱର?
rows.back_en: This... whose voice is this?

rows.speaker: LALLAN
rows.hi: वो रहे! उनके हाथ में कोई जादुई डिब्बा है!
rows.text: ସେଇଠି ଅଛନ୍ତି! ସେମାନଙ୍କ ହାତରେ କିଛି ଯାଦୁ ବାକ୍ସ ଅଛି!
rows.back_en: There they are! They have some magic box in their hands!

rows.speaker: GUDIYA
rows.hi: भागो!
rows.text: ଦୌଡ଼!
rows.back_en: Run!

rows.speaker: JUGAADU CHACHA
rows.hi: रुको! वो अभी तैयार नहीं है!
rows.text: ରୁହ! ସେଇଟା ଏବେ ଯାଏଁ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ ନାହିଁ!
rows.back_en: Wait! That is not ready yet!

rows.speaker: RADIO
rows.hi: रेस! मुझे रेस बहुत पसंद है!
rows.text: ଦୌଡ଼! ମୋତେ ଦୌଡ଼ିବାକୁ ଭାରି ଭଲ ଲାଗେ!
rows.back_en: Run! I love to run!

rows.speaker: CHHOTU
rows.hi: शेरू, अभी नहीं!
rows.text: ଶେରୁ, ଏବେ ନୁହେଁ!
rows.back_en: Sheru, not now!

rows.speaker: CHHOTU
rows.hi: बच गए!
rows.text: ରକ୍ଷା ପାଇଲୁ!
rows.back_en: We are saved!

rows.speaker: GUDIYA
rows.hi: लल्लन चाचा का चेहरा देखा था?
rows.text: ଲଲନ ଦାଦାଙ୍କ ମୁହଁ ଦେଖିଥିଲ?
rows.back_en: Did you see Lalan Uncle's face?

rows.speaker: RADIO
rows.hi: सब बड़े हो गए… अब कोई कहानी सुनने नहीं आता।
rows.text: ସଭିଏଁ ବଡ଼ ହେଲେଣି... କେହି କାହାଣୀ ଶୁଣିବାକୁ ଆସୁନାହାନ୍ତି।
rows.back_en: Everyone has grown up... no one comes to listen to stories anymore.

rows.speaker: RADIO
rows.hi: आज भी बच्चों के लिए लड्डू बनाए थे… पर कोई आया ही नहीं।
rows.text: ଆଜି ବି ପିଲାଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ଲଡ଼ୁ ତିଆରି କରିଥିଲି... କିନ୍ତୁ କେହି ଆସିଲେନି।
rows.back_en: Today also I had made laddus for the children... but no one came.

rows.speaker: GUDIYA
rows.hi: दादी… अकेली बैठी हैं।
rows.text: ଜେଜେମା... ଏକୁଟିଆ ବସିଛନ୍ତି।
rows.back_en: Grandma... is sitting alone.

rows.speaker: CHHOTU
rows.hi: सुबह दादी ने बुलाया था… मैंने कहा, "बाद में, दादी।"
rows.text: ସକାଳେ ଜେଜେମା ଡାକିଥିଲେ... ମୁଁ କହିଲି, "ପରେ ଯିବି, ଜେଜେମା।"
rows.back_en: In the morning Grandma called... I said, "I'll go later, Grandma."

rows.speaker: LALLAN
rows.hi: हम सब मेले में थे… और दादी यहाँ अकेली।
rows.text: ଆମେ ସମସ୍ତେ ମେଳାରେ ଥିଲୁ... ଆଉ ଜେଜେମା ଏଠି ଏକୁଟିଆ।
rows.back_en: We were all at the fair... and Grandma is here alone.

rows.speaker: MASTERJI
rows.hi: सच ही कहा था रेडियो ने।
rows.text: ରେଡିଓ ସତ କଥା କହିଥିଲା।
rows.back_en: The radio spoke the truth.

rows.speaker: JUGAADU CHACHA
rows.hi: कुछ बातें रेडियो से नहीं… पास बैठने से सुनाई देती हैं।
rows.text: କିଛି କଥା ରେଡିଓରୁ ନୁହେଁ... ପାଖରେ ବସିଲେ ହିଁ ଶୁଭିଥାଏ।
rows.back_en: Some things are not heard from a radio... they are only heard when you sit close.

rows.speaker: CHHOTU
rows.hi: दादी! मेला हम आपके पास ले आए!
rows.text: ଜେଜେମା! ମେଳାକୁ ତୁମ ପାଖକୁ ନେଇଆସିଲୁ!
rows.back_en: Grandma! We brought the fair to you!

rows.speaker: DADI
rows.hi: अरे! तुम सब यहाँ? मेला छोड़कर?
rows.text: ଆରେ! ତୁମେ ସଭେ ଇନେ? ମେଲା ଛାଡ଼ି କରି?
rows.back_en: Oh! You all are here? Leaving the fair?

rows.speaker: CHHOTU
rows.hi: सॉरी दादी। सुबह आपने बुलाया था और मैं नहीं आया।
rows.text: ଦୁଃଖିତ ଜେଜେମା। ସକାଳେ ତୁମେ ଡାକିଥିଲ ଆଉ ମୁଁ ଆସିଲିନି।
rows.back_en: Sorry Grandma. You called in the morning and I didn't come.

rows.speaker: DADI
rows.hi: अरे पगले… तू आ गया, यही बहुत है।
rows.text: ଆରେ ବାୟା... ତୁଇଁ ଆସିଲୁ, ଏତକି ବହୁତ୍।
rows.back_en: Oh silly child... you came, that is more than enough.

rows.speaker: GUDIYA
rows.hi: दादी, कहानी सुनाइए ना!
rows.text: ଜେଜେମା, କାହାଣୀ ଶୁଣାଅ ନା!
rows.back_en: Grandma, please tell us a story!

rows.speaker: DADI
rows.hi: तो सुनो… मेरी पहली दिवाली की कहानी। तब इस गाँव में बिजली भी नहीं थी…
rows.text: ହେଲେ ଶୁନ୍... ମୋର୍ ପହେଲି ଦିହାର୍ କାହାନୀ। ସେତେବେଲେ୍ ଇ ଗାଁନେ ବିଜୁଲି ବି ନାଇଁଥିଲା...
rows.back_en: Then listen... the story of my first Diwali. Back then, there wasn't even electricity in this village...

rows.speaker: DADI
rows.hi: उस रात पूरे गाँव में सिर्फ़ दीये जल रहे थे। मेरी दादी हम सब बच्चों को अपने पास बिठातीं…
rows.text: ସେ ରାତିର୍ ସାରା ଗାଁନେ ଖାଲି ଦିଆ ଜଲୁଥିଲା। ମୋର୍ ବୁଢ଼ୀମା ଆମକୁ ପାଖେ ବସଉଥିଲେ...
rows.back_en: That night, only lamps were burning in the whole village. My grandmother used to make us sit close...

rows.speaker: DADI
rows.hi: …और कहतीं — दीया तभी जलता है, जब उसमें प्यार का तेल हो।
rows.text: ...ଆରୁ କହୁଥିଲେ - ଦିଆ ସେଭ୍‌ଲେ୍ ଜଲେ, ଯେଭ୍‌ଲେ୍ ସେଥିର୍ ସ୍ନେହର୍ ତେଲ୍ ଥିବା।
rows.back_en: ...and she used to say - a lamp only burns when there is the oil of love in it.

rows.speaker: LALLAN
rows.hi: और ये लीजिए दादी — मेरी मिठाई। आज पूरी चीनी वाली!
rows.text: ଆଉ ଏଇଟା ନିଅନ୍ତୁ ଜେଜେମା — ମୋ ମିଠା। ଆଜି ପୂରା ଚିନି ଦିଆ!
rows.back_en: And take this, Grandma — my sweet. Today it is fully filled with sugar!

rows.speaker: EVERYONE
rows.hi: हाहाहा!
rows.text: ହା ହା ହା!
rows.back_en: Ha ha ha!

rows.speaker: DADI
rows.hi: बच्चो, दिवाली दीयों से नहीं… अपनों के साथ बैठने से रोशन होती है।
rows.text: ବାବୁରେ, ଦିହାର୍ ଖାଲି ଦିଆନେ ନାଇଁ... ନିଜର୍ ଲୋକର୍ ସାଙ୍ଗେ ବସଲେ ଜଲ୍‌ସି।
rows.back_en: My dear, Diwali doesn't just glow with lamps... it glows when you sit with your loved ones.

rows.speaker: GUDIYA
rows.hi: मास्टरजी, आज कॉपी नहीं — आज दिवाली!
rows.text: ମାଷ୍ଟ୍ରେ, ଆଜି ଖାତା ନୁହେଁ — ଆଜି ଦୀପାବଳି!
rows.back_en: Teacher, not notebooks today — today is Diwali!

rows.speaker: MASTERJI
rows.hi: अरे… मेरे लिए दीया? बरसों बाद किसी ने…
rows.text: ଆରେ... ମୋ ପାଇଁ ଦୀପ? ବହୁତ ବର୍ଷ ପରେ କିଏ...
rows.back_en: Oh... a lamp for me? After many years, someone...

rows.speaker: CHHOTU
rows.hi: और कल छुट्टी? <short pause> रेडियो ने बताया था!
rows.text: ଆଉ କାଲି ଛୁଟି? <short pause> ରେଡିଓ କହିଥିଲା!
rows.back_en: And tomorrow is a holiday? <short pause> The radio said so!

rows.speaker: MASTERJI
rows.hi: हाहाहा! ठीक है, ठीक है… कल आधी छुट्टी!
rows.text: ହା ହା ହା! ହଉ ହଉ... କାଲି ଅଧା ଦିନ ଛୁଟି!
rows.back_en: Ha ha ha! Okay, okay... tomorrow is a half-day holiday!

rows.speaker: CHHOTU
rows.hi: चाचा, सॉरी… हमने आपकी मशीन बिना पूछे ले ली।
rows.text: ଦାଦା, ଦୁଃଖିତ... ଆମେ ତୁମ ମେସିନ୍ ନ ପଚାରି ନେଇଗଲୁ।
rows.back_en: Uncle, sorry... we took your machine without asking.

rows.speaker: JUGAADU CHACHA
rows.hi: रेडियो की चिंता नहीं थी, बेटा… दिवाली पर मैं भी तो अकेला था।
rows.text: ରେଡିଓ କଥା ଚିନ୍ତା ନଥିଲା ପୁଅ... ଦୀପାବଳିରେ ମୁଁ ବି ତ ଏକୁଟିଆ ଥିଲି।
rows.back_en: I wasn't worried about the radio, son... I was alone too on Diwali.

rows.speaker: GUDIYA
rows.hi: अब नहीं! चलिए, दादी कहानी सुना रही हैं!
rows.text: ଆଉ ନୁହେଁ! ଚାଲନ୍ତୁ, ଜେଜେମା କାହାଣୀ କହୁଛନ୍ତି!
rows.back_en: Not anymore! Come on, Grandma is telling a story!

rows.speaker: JUGAADU CHACHA
rows.hi: सच? चलो चलो! पर पहले… जलेबी!
rows.text: ସତେ? ଚାଲ ଚାଲ! କିନ୍ତୁ ଆଗେ... ଜିଲାପି!
rows.back_en: Really? Let's go, let's go! But first... jalebi!

rows.speaker: RADIO
rows.hi: अब तो लड्डू मिलेगा?
rows.text: ଏବେ ତ ଲଡ଼ୁ ମିଳିବ?
rows.back_en: Will I get a laddu now?

rows.speaker: JUGAADU CHACHA
rows.hi: हाहाहा! इसका तो पक्का मिलेगा!
rows.text: ହା ହା ହା! ୟାକୁ ତ ନିଶ୍ଚୟ ମିଳିବ!
rows.back_en: Ha ha ha! He will definitely get one!

rows.speaker: END CARD
rows.hi: बड़ों के साथ समय बिताओ — उन्हें हमारी उतनी ही ज़रूरत है जितनी हमें उनकी।
rows.text: ଗୁରୁଜନଙ୍କ ସହ ସମୟ ବିତାନ୍ତୁ — ସେମାନଙ୍କୁ ଆମର ସେତିକି ଆବଶ୍ୟକ, ଯେତିକି ଆମକୁ ସେମାନଙ୍କର।
rows.back_en: Spend time with elders — they need us as much as we need them.
